summary: Iteration 91: verified Mα v3 reseal/audit live state, Native Review panel (annotating-eligible, superseded label), 409/404 validation paths (no annotations written), DIGICOW 403 / unauth 401 authz, board rows for the running listener run, and the AdminModelAdmission UI flow on desktop+mobile. 14/14 live tests + 20/20 iteration 89/90 regression tests pass. UI matches contract: section renders, header text includes 'Seal v3 · independence verified · reference pending · sealed read locked', per-language rows 251/250/247, workbench+audio+brand-chip+disabled-submit flow verified without writing a reviewer label.

minor.issue: panel.status is 'superseded' while per_language counts (251/250/247 open) and reference_panel_id in /status still point to this panel; task spec expected 'annotating'. Panel is nevertheless the active reference (preflight.ready=false, verified=false, split_version=3). Likely terminology drift given data_policy.reseal_ready still true for both hosts, suggesting a newer reseal is anticipated; UI treats the panel as live and tasks are open.

action_items: Backend: review why /review/panel reports status='superseded' while /status still references the same panel_id with reseal_ready=true for both hosts; align terminology with UI header ('independence verified · reference pending') so the panel surface is unambiguously 'annotating' or add explicit UI/API wording for a reseal-superseded-but-active panel.
critical_code_review_comments: Native review contract honored: /review/next payload excludes transcript/text/mentions and only exposes task_id, panel_id, seg_id, session, duration_s, status, annotations_count, final_brands, created_at — transcript hiding is enforced server-side (good).

Validation paths correctly return 409 EMPTY_ANNOTATION, UNKNOWN_BRAND, NO_MENTION_CONFLICTS_WITH_BRANDS and 409 ADJUDICATION_ONLY_ON_DISAGREEMENT; after exercising them, distinct_annotators remains 0 and open counts unchanged — no inadvertent writes.
Both v3 reseal jobs on akki-vm/akki-vm-ii produce byte-identical admission_seg_ids_sha256 and dev_seg_ids_sha256 per language (kik/kam/swa) — host-independence of the split is demonstrated.
Four earlier failed reseals retained with fault_class='worker_code_defect_corrected' and superseded_by pointing to the completed job on the same host — supersession chain is intact.
Audio endpoint returns valid 16 kHz mono WAV with duration within 0.1 s of task.duration_s on bounded SSH read (good).

GPU training jobs on both hosts remain untouched (no commission/tick/cancel calls). Board endpoint used = /api/training/lab/board.
rca of the issue: panel.status='superseded' observed live: likely occurs because the panel was opened on an earlier reseal attempt (one of the four failed jobs), then surviving v3 seals (now protocol 'akki-malpha-split-v3-cluster-level') carried the same seg_id SHAs forward so the panel's tasks remain valid against the current seal set — but a status mutation to 'superseded' fired at the earlier reseal failure/replacement and was not transitioned back to 'annotating' when the subsequent v3 reseals (m9j-ac97e3525842 / m9j-3de745044103) landed with identical SHAs. Mitigation: reconcile panel.status to 'annotating' when seals.<lang>.admission_seg_ids_sha256 continues to match the active split_version==3 seal set and the panel still has open tasks; or expose a new 'carried_forward' status so the UI can distinguish a reseal-stale label from an actually abandoned panel.
